items.title: Sandisk and Kioxia Plan to Invest More Than $31 Billion in Japanese Memory Plants — About 60% of What They Have Spent There in 25 Years.

items.title: Sandisk’s (SNDK) $31B Japan Bet Raises A Bigger Question
items.summary: On August 27, Sandisk (NASDAQ:SNDK) and Japan’s Kioxia said they would invest more than $31 billion in Japan through 2032, expanding memory chip production as the AI boom drains supply faster than the industry can replace it.
